full_judgment: 2. The short fact that will be necessary for the disposal of the Rule is that, the plaintiff opposite party no.1 filed Title suit No. 186 of 1987. On the objection of the defendants as to the valuation of the suit the plaint was returned to the learned Advocate for the plaintiff for filing before the appropriate court. Thereafter the plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 515 of 1987 in the court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for declaration of his title and recovery of khas possession. The plaint case, 'is that the suit land measuring .13 decimals of land out of C.S. plot no. 1566 comprising a total area of 2.30 acres. One Chandra Mondal was the original owner of the suit plot who sold it to Rahim Box Bepari and Rahim Box possessed it for some time and after his death his heirs by registered kabala dated 24.4.67 sold .13 decimals of land' out of those suit plot to this plaintiff. The de- fondants having dispossessed, the plaintiff" filed the suit for declaration and recovery of khas Possession. In the plaint the boundary of the land was shown as: On the north 	purchased land of Abdur Rob One the south purchased Ian of Rezia Begum On the east. land of vendors On the west 	public road. While the application for temporary injunction was pending the petitioners filed written objection claiming that they have purchased 17 1/2 decimals of land out of C.S. plot no. 1566 from the lawful heirs of Chandra Nath Mondal. In the written objection it has been specifically stated that Rahim Box did not purchase any land of C.S. plot no. 1566 and as such neither Rahim Box nor his heirs ever possessed any land of this plot.
